title: Smart Sampayan
description: Traditional sampayan systems rely entirely on manual operation and do not respond to sudden weather changes such as rainfall. As a result, clothes left unattended during rain become wet again, causing inconvenience, additional labor, and inefficiency in household tasks. Furthermore, individuals are often forced to rush and manually retrieve their drying clothes when it suddenly rains, which can be difficult or impossible when they are not at home or immediately available.

title: Smart Blind Control
description: Automated blind control system that adjusts based on sunlight intensity and room temperature, providing optimal lighting conditions while saving energy. The system uses light sensors and temperature monitoring to automatically raise or lower blinds throughout the day then monitor and controls via webserver.

title: Smart Dog Dispenser
description: An intelligent pet feeder that dispenses food at scheduled times and can be controlled remotely via web server. Includes portion control, meal scheduling, and real-time monitoring of your pet's feeding habits. Perfect for busy pet owners who want to ensure their dogs are fed on time.
